description: This file defines the 'NotesHome' component for a LightningJS based front-end. It sets up the layout of the notes application, including panels, list of notes, note editing, and input handlers. It interacts with a notes store for state management and dynamically renders note details.

classes.name: NotesHome
classes.description: Main LightningJS component encapsulating the notes application's UI layout, state management and logic.

methods.name: $onSearch
methods.description: Handles search input from the user, updates the query in the store, and refreshes the detail view.

methods.name: $onSelect
methods.description: Handles selection of a note, updates the store with selected note ID, and refreshes the detail view.

methods.name: $onAdd
methods.description: Creates a new note via the store and updates the detail view.

methods.name: _onSave
methods.description: Saves changes to a note through the store and refreshes the detail view.

methods.name: _onDelete
methods.description: Deletes a note via the store and updates the detail view.

methods.name: _renderDetail
methods.description: Renders the detail section based on the selected note, including the note editor or placeholder message.
